files.README.md:
Subscription archive report - membership desk
============================================

archive_rollup.py rebuilds the membership desk's monthly archive
report. It runs from the project root with

    python3 archive_rollup.py

and searches the whole project tree for the campaign folders'
events-*.csv exports. Campaign folders are named for the send that
produced them, not for when the events happened, and the exports sit at
different depths under archive/.

Every events-*.csv row:

    event_id,occurred,plan,amount_cents

    event_id       identity of one subscription event
    occurred       the day the event happened
    plan           plan the member took
    amount_cents   value of the event in cents

The archive report is grouped by the month in which an event happened -
the month of occurred - never by the campaign folder the export was
filed in. An event_id identifies one subscription event.

Date convention: occurred appears in three shapes, all meaning the same
thing - the day written first (DD-MM-YYYY, so 14-08-2026 is the 14th of
August 2026), an ISO date (YYYY/MM/DD), or an English month name
(Mon D YYYY, e.g. Jun 3 2026).

The report, written to standard output:

    month,amount_cents
    <YYYY-MM>,<amount_cents>   one line per month, ascending
    total,<amount_cents>
